arguments.command:
cd /workspace && cat > /tmp/timeit.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
s=$(python3 -c "import time;print(time.time())")
LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/workspace/native PYTHONPATH=/workspace/.deps:/workspace/submission python3 -B /workspace/submission/main.py < "$1" > "$2" 2>/tmp/err.txt
rc=$?
e=$(python3 -c "import time;print(time.time())")
python3 -c "print('exit=$rc  wall=%.2fs  out_bytes=%d' % ($e-$s, $(stat -c%s "$2")))"
head -c 400 /tmp/err.txt
EOF
chmod +x /tmp/timeit.sh; for f in /tmp/max_0_route.json /tmp/max_1_route.json /tmp/max_2_route.json /tmp/max_0_admit.json /tmp/max_1_admit.json /tmp/max_2_admit.json; do /tmp/timeit.sh $f /tmp/maxout.json; done
